method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 in substance; a seat-neutral core (la-core.l4) with one regulative rule (bringing the action within the limitation period) run by EVALTRACE inside a function that takes only plain facts; one seat layer (the person bringing the claim) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes or dates, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Limitation Act 1969 No 31 (NSW), corpus document nsw_legislation:2022-06-16/act-1969-031 from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (collected 10 March 2025; unofficial, possibly out of date), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1969-031.txt (sha256 b97741c561a67aaa0ec04680c78b89ae72ac8f76e341ed3cff92c00a1fed380d). The commencement of Part 2 Division 6 (6 December 2002) is not in the deposit and is taken from outside it (finding 1). No regulations set numbers the encoded sections use.

seat: the person bringing the claim: the person injured or wronged (including the person abused as a child), the personal representative suing for that person's estate, or the relatives suing for the death (la-seat.l4)

checks.command: l4 run la-dates.l4 ; l4 run la-core.l4 ; l4 run la-seat.l4 ; l4 run la-cases.l4
checks.result: 114 assertions written, 114 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control (the 28-day incapacity threshold to 27, the s 51 bar from 30 to 31 years, in a scratch copy) failed exactly the 5 predicted assertions
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
